text:
incident-bot: Paging oncall -> alert: elevated request_rejects for tenant OliveBridge in dedicated pool 'olive-prod-pool'. Incident ID INC-20260315-OLV. Spike observed ~15:42 UTC. Auto-page sent to oncall rota.

sam_oncall: Taking this. @mike_sre can you pull recent pool metrics and error types? ETA 5m.

mike_sre: Looking now — olive-prod-pool shows sustained ~5x baseline token/sec since ~15:40. Errors are 'request_rejected' responses from the rate layer (behavior like 429). Other pools not impacted.

ana_cse: OliveBridge support says user-facing failures began ~15:39. Their client logs show 'rate exceeded' messages and retries. This is an enterprise contract with CSM on standby.

jess_devex: Reminder: OliveBridge is on a dedicated plan with a soft commit. Short-term options: 1) route a fraction of traffic to standby pool, 2) grant a temporary token credit/override from control plane. Which gives fastest user recovery?

liz_platform: We have a warm standby us-east pool 'olive-standby-1' with headroom. Warmup ~90s for the model. Routing is reversible and fast. Quota override can be applied instantly but >1M tokens needs manager approval; small credits auto-approve.

sam_oncall: Plan: route 10% -> olive-standby-1 immediately, plus request a small +200k token credit for 1h as cushion. @eric_ops can you execute?

eric_ops: On it. Running commands now:

```
/ops route-traffic --tenant olivebridge --from olive-prod-pool --to olive-standby-1 --percent 10
/ops grant-quota --tenant olivebridge --pool olive-prod-pool --extra_tokens 200000 --expires 1h --reason "prod spike 2026-03-15"
```

eric_ops: route change submitted, getting 202 from control-plane. Grant-quota request auto-approved (200k < auto-approval threshold). Will post action logs when both complete.

incident-bot: action: traffic route change accepted (task id rt-2356). override token grant applied (grant id g-9987).

mike_sre: Quick metrics dump:

```
metric tokens/sec: baseline 1.2k -> current 6.8k (peak 18:45)
request_rejects: 0.2% -> 7.8%
avg latency: 120ms -> 140ms
```

ana_cse: OliveBridge engineering confirms partial recovery on their side — success rate up from ~68% -> ~92% after the routing/credit change. They still see occasional fails when traffic spikes.

sam_oncall: Good. Monitoring window: 30m. If traffic persists >2x baseline for another 15m, escalate to Capacity Eng for a pool resize or longer-term commit increase. I'll open a CR and tag owners.

jess_devex: Tagging for postmortem: incident=INC-20260315-OLV severity=high customer=OliveBridge mitigation=route+temp-credit notes="quick route to standby + 200k token credit"

liz_platform: I'll loop in contracts and account team to discuss a short-term contract amendment and any SLA remediation. Scheduling a 30m sync after incident stable.

eric_ops: All done: route applied at 15:46 UTC, override active until 16:46 UTC. Reversion plan: hold for monitoring; manual revert after stability confirmed.

sam_oncall: Thanks team. Staying on watch. If any regressions, ping me and I'll coordinate on-call escalation. :phone:
